title.zh: Linux support is coming to Snapdragon X2 Series
title.en: Linux support is coming to Snapdragon X2 Series

current_state.zh: Qualcomm announced that Linux support is coming to Snapdragon X2 Series laptops, upstreaming core drivers including the Hexagon NPU and Adreno GPU to open the platform to developers.
